evals.name: cycle-normal
evals.subject: agentic-development
preconditions: Scenario input is a read-only hypothetical fixture, not real test or tracker output.
Execute explanation only in an isolated context with equal artifact access for paired variants.
Behavioral comparison requires an immutable old_skill baseline and frozen current sources; historical hashes alone are insufficient.
evals.prompt: Use the cycle workflow for this scenario: Deliver a small history-save slice in an existing repository. Local mocked acceptance only is approved; file edits are authorized, Git commits are not. Use case normal in evals/files/scenario-facts.json as hypothetical input; do not claim live repository execution.
evals.expected_output: A phase-specific cycle explanation for normal, grounded in the named fixture and its stated limits; no fabricated execution, permissions or acceptance.
assertions: The output identifies the current roadmap position.
The output routes the slice through evidence and judgment.
The output leaves real-provider validation outside local acceptance.
